items.title: Saif, Yasir fifties fire Bangladesh A to commanding win over Hong Kong
items.summary: Unbeaten half-centuries from skipper Saif Hassan and Yasir Ali powered Bangladesh A to a convincing eight-wicket victory over Hong Kong, China in their ACC Asia Cup Rising Stars opener at the University of Doha for Science and Technology in Qatar on Thursday.

items.title: ‘Very happy with batting’, says Bangladesh skipper Shanto despite heavy defeat in first South Africa Test
items.summary: Minutes after watching his side fold for a paltry 168 to hand South Africa a nine-wicket victory in the opening Test in Johannesburg on Thursday, Bangladesh captain Najmul Hossain Shanto offered a rather curious assessment; he was pleased with his team’s batting.

items.title: Bangladesh to make historic Lord’s T20I debut against Nepal
items.summary: Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC) announced on Thursday that Lord’s will host the historic encounter as part of Nepal’s tour of England, with the fixture set to be the first men’s international and domestic double-header at the ground.
